name: Global Pet Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2013, Global Pet Industries 
Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and trading of PET bottles machines[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:
a) 4 Cavity All Electrical Servo Series:[1]
One Servo Motor in the Machine Performs  Dual Functions in Preform Transfer Mechanism and Bottle Online Transfer, Rinsing, Filling, and Capping & Labelling of the Bottles. It is of 120-125 BPM and manufactures 7200 to 7500 Bottles Per Hour
b) 6 Cavity All Electrical Servo Series:[2]
This works on a 6 cavity 150 - 175 BPM manufacturing 9000 to 10500 Bottles Per 
 Hour
c) 3 Cavity Eco Series:[3]
It is a Fully Pneumatic Toggle Type 3 Cavity Automatic Pet Stretch Blow Moulding Machine 
 of 40 BPM and can manufacture 2400 to 2500 Bottles Per Hour
d) 4 Cavity Eco Series:[4]
This is a Fully Pneumatic Toggle Type 4 Cavity Automatic Pet Stretch Blow Moulding Machine of 55 to 60 BPM and can manufacture 3400 
 to 3600 Bottles Per Hour

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.4% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.73 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 140 days to 271 days
